title: encrypt() panics on RNG failure instead of returning Err
description: encrypt.rs:99 uses UnwrapErr(SysRng) — UnwrapErr wraps SysRng and panics if the OS RNG call fails (e.g. /dev/urandom unavailable, getrandom syscall blocked by seccomp). A panic in library code is worse than returning Err: it cannot be caught by the caller. The fix is to map the RNG error into SmimeError::Other rather than wrapping in UnwrapErr.
close_reason: Fixed encrypt() to propagate RNG errors: ECDH via try_generate_from_rng, CEK/IV via getrandom::fill, from_slice deprecated calls replaced with try_from().expect(). RSA still uses local UnwrapErr(SysRng) as rsa crate requires CryptoRng.
